import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/input.xlsx', data_only=False)
lines=[]
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    lines.append('SHEET '+ws.title+' '+str(ws.max_row)+'x'+str(ws.max_column)+' merges '+str(len(ws.merged_cells.ranges)))
    formulas=[]; blanks=[]; vals=[]
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for c in row:
            if c.value is None:
                blanks.append(c.coordinate)
            elif isinstance(c.value,str) and c.value.startswith('='):
                formulas.append(c.coordinate+': '+c.value)
            else:
                vals.append(c.coordinate+': '+repr(c.value)[:80])
    lines.append('FORMULAS '+str(len(formulas)))
    lines += formulas[:500]
    lines.append('BLANKS '+str(len(blanks))+' first '+','.join(blanks[:100]))
    lines.append('VALUES '+str(len(vals))+' first')
    lines += vals[:80]
open('/workspace/info.txt','w').write('\n'.join(lines))
print('OK')
PY
